caption: Flamingos, polar bears, octopuses. Two of these are true and one is lying straight to your face. Almost everyone gets the middle one wrong — and the reason why is genuinely strange. What did you pick?

carousel.hook: Your kid will beat you at this.

carousel.caption: Real or fake? Three animal facts, and the one that sounds most obvious is the lie. This is from Trick Trivia, a real-or-fake guessing game book for kids ages 7 to 13: 210 facts, full-colour comic illustrations, and every page is a new round. It is the screen-free road trip game, dinner table game and classroom brain break that kids actually ask for, because the whole point is beating the adults. Comment your score out of 3, then show your kid and see who wins.
